description: Content-first: enrich content/tracks.json in place (2 lessons + one 5-question mastery per level across all 9 levels, plus a required disclaimer on the personal-finance track), tighten scripts/validate-catalog.mjs to enforce the enriched schema, and author content/CONTENT-REVIEW.md as the semantic review record. Depends on nothing. Must leave the validator passing against the authored content. This is the data every later FEAT reads; design sections 3 and 4. Independent of FEAT-002..004 except that they build on its content.
steps: Enrich /Users/Shared/goalie/content/tracks.json following design-phase2.md section 3.2 EXACTLY: for each of the 9 levels add a `lessons` array of length EXACTLY 2 and one `mastery` object. Keep schemaVersion:1 and only ADD fields (never remove/retype existing ones). Each lesson: non-empty id,title,objective,explanation,workedExample,nextStep and a `practice` object with non-empty prompt,answer,answerExplanation. Lesson id convention (binding): `<trackId>-<levelId>-<n>` with the LITERAL track id (computer-science|economics|personal-finance) and literal level id (beginner|intermediate|advanced), n 1-based. Each `mastery`: non-empty `passRule` string and `questions` of length EXACTLY 5; each question has a globally-unique non-empty id `<trackId>-<levelId>-m<n>`, non-empty prompt, `options` of length EXACTLY 4 (all non-empty strings), integer `correctIndex` in 0..3 with exactly ONE defensible correct answer. ALL lesson ids and question ids globally unique across the catalog. Hand-check every numeric worked example and every correctIndex. Original prose only; no copyrighted text.

Add a non-empty top-level `disclaimer` string field to the `personal-finance` track ONLY (e.g. 'Educational content only. This is general information, not personalized investment, tax, legal, credit, or debt advice.'), per design 3.5.

Tighten /Users/Shared/goalie/scripts/validate-catalog.mjs per design 3.3, keeping all existing checks (schemaVersion, track id uniqueness, title/description present, exact level ids in order, required starter tracks). Inside the level loop ADD: exactly-2-lessons check; per-lesson required non-empty id/title/objective/explanation/workedExample/nextStep and a practice object with non-empty prompt/answer/answerExplanation; `level.mastery` must be an object with a non-empty `passRule` and a `questions` array of length exactly 5; per-question non-empty id/prompt, Array.isArray(options)&&length===4 with all non-empty strings, Number.isInteger(correctIndex)&&0<=correctIndex<=3. Maintain two Sets (lessonIds, questionIds) across the whole walk and push an error on any duplicate. Require a non-empty string `disclaimer` on the personal-finance track specifically. Keep it plain Node ESM with NO new deps; keep process.exitCode=1 on any error. Replace the hard-coded success line with one computed from accumulated levelCount/lessonCount/questionCount (e.g. '<levelCount> levels, <lessonCount> lessons, <questionCount> mastery questions checked').

Author /Users/Shared/goalie/content/CONTENT-REVIEW.md per design 3.4: open with a statement that all content is original prose of general, widely-accepted facts and that numeric worked examples and every mastery correctIndex were hand-checked for a single defensible correct answer; then a three-column table (item id | kind of source basis as a CATEGORY only, never copyrighted text | reviewed: yes/no) covering EVERY lesson id and EVERY mastery check. Set reviewed:yes only after performing the stated check. Every lesson/question id authored in tracks.json must appear in the table.
acceptance_criteria: node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs exits 0 and prints the computed success line reporting 9 levels, 18 lessons, and 45 mastery questions checked against the enriched content.

content/tracks.json has exactly 2 lessons and exactly 5 mastery questions per level across all 9 levels, schemaVersion still 1, with all lesson/question ids globally unique and following the <trackId>-<levelId>-<n> / -m<n> convention.
The personal-finance track has a non-empty disclaimer field and the validator fails if it is missing (verifiable on a scratch copy).
content/CONTENT-REVIEW.md exists and lists every authored lesson id and mastery-check with a source-basis category and reviewed:yes.
npx tsc --noEmit stays clean (the tracks.json import is unaffected by the additive content change).
findings: Content enriched in content/tracks.json (schemaVersion still 1, additive only). ID scheme used (binding, literal ids, 1-based n): lessons `<trackId>-<levelId>-<n>` e.g. computer-science-beginner-1, computer-science-beginner-2; mastery questions `<trackId>-<levelId>-m<n>` e.g. computer-science-beginner-m1..m5. trackIds: computer-science, economics, personal-finance. levelIds: beginner, intermediate, advanced. Totals: 9 levels, 18 lessons (2/level), 45 mastery questions (one 5-question single-correct MCQ mastery per level). Every level has a `mastery` object with fields `passRule` (string) and `questions` (array of {id, prompt, options[4], correctIndex 0..3}). Each lesson has id/title/objective/explanation/workedExample/nextStep and a `practice` object {prompt, answer, answerExplanation}. The personal-finance track has a top-level `disclaimer` string (educational-only). All lesson ids and question ids are globally unique. The uniform mastery passRule string authored in content is: "Complete both lessons AND answer at least 4 of 5 correctly. Retries allowed; earned progress is never lost." Validator (scripts/validate-catalog.mjs) tightened per design 3.3 (plain Node ESM, no new deps, process.exitCode=1 on error). Its NEW success line (exit 0) wording and counts, computed from the walked data: "Course catalog structure valid: 3 tracks, 9 levels, 18 lessons, 45 mastery questions checked." content/CONTENT-REVIEW.md authored listing every lesson id and every mastery check with a source-basis category and reviewed:yes. Verification passed: `node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs` exit 0 with the line above; `npx tsc --noEmit` clean (additive JSON fields do not affect the existing loadCatalog import/typecheck). Confirmed on a scratch copy that removing the personal-finance disclaimer makes the validator exit 1. NOTE for FEAT-002: catalog.types.ts/catalog.ts were intentionally NOT modified here (out of FEAT-001 scope); the current loadCatalog only reads lesson id/title/objective so the enriched JSON still parses. FEAT-002 must enrich those types/parser to mirror the tightened validator (lessons length 2, mastery 5 questions, options length 4, correctIndex 0..3, personal-finance disclaimer).
